name: FlashPDE
description: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) solve PDEs by incorporating physical constraints into neural-network training, but large-scale problems are limited by automatic-differentiation memory overhead and inefficient execution of grid-based PDE operators. We present FlashPDE, a drop-in fused operator library for grid-based scientific machine learning. FlashPDE replaces fragmented PyTorch finite-difference execution with differentiable Triton kernels.
